## Biographical Information

lame friend of the Jones-Batemans

CMY describes this woman to [Florence Wilford](person_1520.qmd) as 'sister of Mr Rowland Hill'.  Unfortunately, there are several possible Rowland Hills, and it is uncertain which CMY means here.
